surprise_split_note: auto = min(forecast, DA) residual and inherits the week-0 pin, so it trends to zero regardless of the tape. A large editorial number against a near-zero auto is a REAL disagreement worth reading, not an error in either direction.
doctrine: Surprise = how far reality drifted from BOTH our prediction lines. High consecutive surprise = the cycle is doing something neither model predicted = regime change. Spike alone could be noise; sustained high is the tell.
